title: IMU Basics

hints.title: Getting the IMU from the hardware map
hints.content: Use `IMU imu = hardwareMap.get(IMU.class, "imu");` -- just like getting a motor, but with `IMU.class`.

hints.title: Creating the IMU parameters
Reading the yaw angle
hints.content: First get the angles object: `YawPitchRollAngles angles = imu.getRobotYawPitchRollAngles();` then extract the yaw: `double heading = angles.getYaw(AngleUnit.DEGREES);`

hints.title: Displaying on telemetry
hints.content: Use `telemetry.addData("Heading", heading);` followed by `telemetry.update();` to show the heading value on the Driver Station.
